verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity-management SaaS platform, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any AI insights or suggestions feature. The cited features cover cap tables, share issuance, data rooms, shareholder comms and HRIS integration, none of which involve AI-driven analysis, and the llms.txt probe is machine-readable docs for external LLMs, not an in-product capability.
